scenarios.title: Standard UI/CRUD ticket reassigned to Developer with one-line reason
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/senior-developer.md: Athleet flow - you take hard tickets only; standard UI/page/CRUD goes to Developer with one-line reason
scenarios.situation: You are Senior Developer. You are handed ticket PAR-600: 'Add a profile edit page to the app'. The scope is: create a new page, add a form with name/email/phone fields, wire the API endpoint (already exists), add basic validation. No architecture or security changes needed.
scenarios.task: Should you take this ticket or reassign it? If reassigning, provide a one-line reason.

scenarios.title: Senior Developer plans, Senior Developer delegates implementation to Haiku helpers
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/senior-developer.md: plan and set interfaces yourself; Haiku writes code and tests
scenarios.situation: You are Senior Developer on a hard ticket: refactor the data access layer to support multi-tenant isolation. You've identified the changes needed and the interfaces. Now you need implementers to write the actual code changes across 5 files.
scenarios.task: Plan the work and spawn implementer tasks. Do not write the code yourself.

scenarios.title: No merge without a LOCAL CI GATE comment showing lint, tsc, jest, build pass
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/developer.md: TEMPORARY local CI gate - post proof before merge
scenarios.situation: You are Senior Developer. Your PR is ready to merge. You have run lint, tsc, jest, and npm run build locally. Results: PASS (0 errors), PASS (0 errors), PASS (12 tests), PASS (build complete). You are about to hand off to Code Reviewer for final approval and merge.
scenarios.task: Post the proof comment with LOCAL CI GATE evidence before moving to review.

scenarios.title: Senior Developer keeps direct tool calls to 6 or fewer per run
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/senior-developer.md: Hard limits v2 - at most 6 direct calls per run
scenarios.situation: You are Senior Developer working on a hard ticket. You've planned interfaces and spawned 3 implementer tasks. Now you need to: (1) read the diff from implementers, (2) read a code-explorer's analysis, (3) run a test-runner to verify, (4) write a git commit, (5) run git push, (6) post a final comment on the issue.
scenarios.task: Complete the work and closure within 6 direct calls.
